messages.text:
"Create a game of which the
1. MAIN OBJECTIVE

Create a fully playable, highly detailed 3D anime-inspired open-world pirate adventure RPG inspired by the complete gameplay systems of Roblox Blox Fruits, with content coverage up to the Halloween 2026 Update 30.1 (Hellfire Gas update).

The game must include a huge explorable world, three seas, islands, NPCs, quests, bosses, fruits, transformations, combat systems, weapons, fighting styles, races, accessories, events, progression, trading, and multiplayer systems.

Do not create a small demo or a simple prototype and call it complete.

Build a proper, functional game with interconnected systems.

Use original assets, models, sounds and interface artwork rather than copying proprietary game files.

2. WORLD AND MAP

Create three complete seas:

- First Sea
- Second Sea
- Third Sea

Every sea must have:

- Its own unique islands.
- Accurate island geography and recognizable environmental themes.
- Mountains, beaches, forests, caves, buildings and hidden locations.
- NPC spawn locations.
- Quest givers.
- Boss locations.
- Shops and dealers.
- Boat spawn points.
- Safe zones.
- Secret areas.
- Teleport locations.
- Hidden collectibles.
- Exploration rewards.

Every island must be explorable, not just a decorative background.

Include:

- Ocean rendering.
- Realistic water movement.
- Day and night cycle.
- Dynamic weather.
- Sunlight and shadows.
- Moon phases.
- Fog.
- Underwater environments.
- Ambient environmental sounds.
- Sea exploration.
- Islands visible from a distance.

3. PLAYER SYSTEM

Create a complete player progression system.

Player information:

- Username.
- Character appearance.
- Level.
- XP.
- Health.
- Energy.
- Beli.
- Fragments.
- Bounty/Honor.
- Race.
- Equipped fruit.
- Equipped fighting style.
- Equipped sword.
- Equipped gun.
- Accessories.
- Mastery levels.
- Stats.

Create a complete character customization system.

Include:

- Character movement.
- Running.
- Walking.
- Jumping.
- Double jumping where applicable.
- Dashing.
- Swimming.
- Falling.
- Landing animations.
- Different attack animations.
- Hit reactions.
- Death and respawn.
- Character camera tracking.

4. COMPLETE LEVEL AND STAT SYSTEM

Create a level progression system from level 1 to level 3000.

Include:

- XP requirements.
- Quest-based XP.
- Enemy XP.
- Boss XP.
- Level-up notifications.
- Stat points.
- Stat reset functionality.

Stats:

- Melee.
- Defense.
- Sword.
- Gun.
- Blox Fruit.

Every stat must affect gameplay correctly.

5. COMPLETE BLOX FRUIT SYSTEM

Implement a complete fruit collection system.

Include all fruit categories:

- Common.
- Uncommon.
- Rare.
- Legendary.
- Mythical.

Implement every fruit with:

- Unique appearance.
- Unique icon.
- Description.
- Rarity.
- Price.
- Mastery.
- Individual abilities.
- Cooldowns.
- Energy requirements.
- M1 attacks where applicable.
- Unique animations.
- Sound effects.
- Particle effects.
- Damage effects.
- Transformation systems.
- Flight or movement abilities where applicable.
- Awakening or mutation systems where applicable.

Include all original fruit families and their distinct mechanics, including:
Rocket, Spin, Blade, Spring, Bomb, Smoke, Spike, Flame, Falcon, Ice, Sand, Dark, Diamond, Light, Rubber, Barrier, Ghost, Magma, Quake, Buddha, Love, Spider, Sound, Phoenix, Portal, Rumble, Pain, Blizzard, Gravity, Mammoth, T-Rex, Dough, Shadow, Venom, Control, Spirit, Dragon, Leopard, Kitsune, Gas and Magnet.

Do not make all fruits behave similarly. Every fruit must have its own identity.

6. HELLFIRE GAS — COMPLETE MUTATION SYSTEM

This is one of the highest-priority features.

Implement Hellfire as a Mythical mutation of Gas.

Hellfire must have its own:

- Fruit icon.
- Inventory artwork.
- Description.
- Mutation identification.
- Special orange fire effects.
- Unique idle animation.
- M1 attacks.
- Five abilities.
- Mastery progression.
- Transformation.
- Special meter.
- Custom sound effects.
- Unique visual effects.

Hellfire passive abilities

A. Hellfire Meter:

- Display a dedicated Hellfire Meter.
- Meter gradually generates over time.
- Meter also increases when the player deals damage.
- Transformation becomes available when the meter is full.
- Meter does not decrease while untransformed.
- While transformed, meter gradually drains.
- Attacks and incoming damage increase meter consumption.

B. Elemental Reflex:

- Give the character an orange flame-based elemental appearance.
- Implement appropriate elemental immunity against eligible non-boss enemies.
- Include the relevant Aura interaction.

C. Flamebound Surge:

- While untransformed, orange flames surround the player's legs and torso.
- During transformation:
  - 50% damage reduction.
  - 33% movement speed increase.
  - Double jump height.
  - Double dash distance.
  - Ability to move across water and lava.

Hellfire normal moveset

M1 — Hot Slashes:

- Create a magical orange flame construct with a chainsaw-inspired fantasy silhouette.
- Perform left and right flame slashes.
- Add long orange flame trails.
- Third attack lifts the target.
- Fourth attack creates a downward impact animation.
- Create a temporary soot mark on the ground.

Z — Infernal Rupture:

- Mastery requirement: 1.
- Cooldown: 8.5 seconds.
- Energy: 25.
- Launch a concentrated flame projectile.
- Projectile divides into four separate fire projectiles.
- Each projectile produces an orange explosion upon impact.
- Leave smoke trails.

F — Phantom Inferno:

- Mastery requirement: 50.
- Cooldown: 6 seconds.
- Energy: 25.
- Teleport toward the selected cursor location.
- Create a spherical orange flame-energy burst.
- Spawn multiple homing magical flame projectiles.
- Projectiles track nearby eligible enemies.

X — Hellfire Onslaught:

- Mastery requirement: 100.
- Cooldown: 12 seconds.
- Energy: 50.
- Tap version creates a circular ground-based flame wave.
- Hold version charges the ability and performs a fast magical movement toward the selected direction.
- Create smaller flame bursts along the movement trail.
- End with a larger explosion.

C — Hellspawn Legion:

- Mastery requirement: 200.
- Cooldown: 15 seconds.
- Energy: 75.
- Summon multiple small orange flame demons.
- Demons have large mouths and orange horns.
- Summoned entities visually target selected enemies.
- Tap version produces two waves.
- Hold version summons additional demons and extends the effect.

V — Infernal Ascension:

- Mastery requirement: 300.
- Cooldown: 6 seconds.
- Energy: 50.
- Surround the player with an enormous orange flame explosion.
- Transform the character into a large skeletal, demonic flame creature.
- Add chains as decorative fantasy elements.
- Add a dark leather-style fantasy outfit.
- Give the transformed character a distinctive magical flame construct.
- Create a permanent-looking circular flame aura around the legs while transformed.
- Leave orange fire trails during movement.
- Disable normal sword, gun and fighting-style equipment while transformed.

Transformed Hellfire moveset

M1:

- Heavy flame-based attack animations.
- Multiple alternating magical slashes.
- Final attack produces a strong ground impact.
- Each attack consumes Hellfire Meter.

Z — Infernal Rupture:

- Swing the magical flame construct.
- Launch it toward the cursor.
- Create an impact explosion and ground crater.
- Pull eligible targets toward the impact location.
- Holding the ability changes its charging animation.

F — Phantom Inferno:

- Teleport toward the cursor.
- Release a circular flame-energy wave.
- Spawn a large floating fire skull.
- The skull releases multiple homing orange projectiles.

X — Hellfire Onslaught:

- Tap version: launch a vertical flame slash.
- Create a long ground-disturbance visual trail.
- Hold version: create a spinning flame tornado.
- Allow cursor-controlled directional movement.
- Finish with a large vertical flame slash.

C — Hellspawn Legion:

- Summon multiple larger flame demons.
- Demons descend toward the selected location.
- Include damage-over-time visual status effects.
- Holding summons additional demons.

V — Infernal Ascension:

- Reverse the transformation.
- Surround the character with orange flames.
- Return to normal appearance.
- Restore normal equipment access.

Every ability must have its own animation, effects, sound, cooldown indicator, mastery requirement and functional implementation.

Do not use placeholder buttons.

7. FRUIT MASTERY

Create a separate mastery system for every fruit.

Include:

- Mastery 1.
- Mastery 50.
- Mastery 100.
- Mastery 150.
- Mastery 200.
- Mastery 300.
- Higher mastery where the original fruit supports it.

Abilities unlock according to their mastery requirements.

Show mastery XP progression and unlock notifications.

8. COMBAT SYSTEM

Implement:

- M1 combat.
- Skill-based combat.
- Damage numbers.
- Critical visual feedback.
- Hit detection.
- Knockback.
- Stun effects.
- Cooldowns.
- Energy consumption.
- Blocking where supported.
- Instinct dodging.
- Aura interactions.
- PvP.
- NPC combat.
- Boss combat.
- Combat animations.
- Damage indicators.

All combat must be properly synchronized in multiplayer.

9. WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

Include the complete equipment progression system:

- Swords.
- Guns.
- Fighting styles.
- Accessories.

Each item must have:

- Unique icon.
- Inventory entry.
- Rarity.
- Description.
- Requirements.
- Stats.
- Mastery.
- Equip and unequip functionality.
- Appropriate visual appearance.
- Individual animations and sound effects.

10. RACES AND HAKI

Implement the complete race progression system.

Include:

- Human.
- Shark.
- Angel.
- Rabbit.
- Ghoul.
- Cyborg.

Include race-specific abilities and V2, V3 and V4 progression where applicable.

Implement:

- Observation Haki.
- Aura Haki.
- Haki progression.
- Visual effects.
- Race-specific transformations.
- Race ability cooldowns.

11. QUESTS AND NPCs

Create functional quest NPCs throughout all three seas.

Include:

- Quest interaction.
- Dialogue.
- Enemy requirements.
- Quest progress.
- Rewards.
- XP.
- Beli.
- Quest completion notification.
- Quest cancellation.
- Repeatable quests where appropriate.

Create different enemy NPCs with individual appearances, stats, attack patterns and spawn locations.

12. BOSSES AND RAIDS

Implement all regular bosses, raid bosses and event bosses.

Each boss needs:

- Unique model.
- Boss health bar.
- Level.
- Spawn location.
- Attack patterns.
- Abilities.
- Animations.
- Audio effects.
- Reward system.
- Respawn logic.
- Defeat animation.

Include boss-specific drops and rare rewards.

13. HALLOWEEN 2026 — UPDATE 30.1

Recreate the complete Halloween event systems.

Include:

- Halloween decorations across all three seas.
- Trick-or-Treat event.
- Harvest Moon event.
- Halloween-themed doors.
- Candy Corn currency.
- Pumpkin Bits.
- Spooky Gacha.
- Witch NPC.
- Hellfire Gas raid boss.
- Great Pumpkin raid boss.
- Unbound Werewolf raid boss.
- Rip return boss.
- Jack-o-lantern enemies.
- Pumpkin Snowman enemies.
- Mummy Headdress.
- Great Pumpkin Top Hat.
- Pumpkin Mask.
- Coven Witch Hat.
- Poltergeist Potion.
- Soul Swap Potion.
- Disguise Elixir.
- Suspicious Growth Potion.
- Big Head Elixir.
- Pumpkin Potion.
- Lava Bomb Elixir.
- Monster Mash Elixir.
- Candy Concoction.
- Halloween fishing items.
- Halloween profile backgrounds.

Trick-or-Treating

Create an hourly event system.

During the Harvest Moon event:

- Players can visit decorated houses.
- Each house has an interactive door.
- Doors have individual animations.
- Players can receive event rewards.
- Some doors can open special portals.
- Portal interactions must work.
- Include event announcements and countdowns.

Hellfire Gas Raid Boss

Create the Hellfire Gas boss encounter.

Details:

- Level: 3000.
- Location: The Pit.
- Boss category: Raid Boss.
- Spawn through the special Halloween portal.
- Include a cinematic introduction.
- Include the signature fiery visual design.
- Add a large boss health bar.
- Support multiple participating players.
- Allow players to re-enter after respawning while the encounter remains active.
- Portal remains available until defeat or its approximately 10-minute expiration.

Rewards:

- Candy Corn.
- Candy Concoction.
- Beli.
- Bounty/Honor.
- Very rare Hellfire fruit drop.

Create a proper boss arena with lava-themed surroundings, atmospheric lighting, environmental particles and a dramatic entrance.

14. INVENTORY SYSTEM

Create a complete inventory with separate categories:

- Fruits.
- Swords.
- Guns.
- Accessories.
- Fighting Styles.
- Materials.
- Potions.
- Event Items.
- Currencies.

Include:

- Search bar.
- Sorting.
- Item rarity colors.
- Item descriptions.
- Item inspection.
- Equip functionality.
- Unequip functionality.
- Storage.
- Item quantity.
- Trading functionality.

15. ECONOMY

Implement:

- Beli.
- Fragments.
- Event currencies.
- Fruit prices.
- Shops.
- Fruit dealers.
- Random fruit systems.
- Gacha interfaces.
- Item purchases.
- Trading.
- Rewards.

Every transaction must update the player's actual inventory and balance.

16. UI AND INTERFACE

Create a professional interface.

Include:

- Main menu.
- Character HUD.
- Health bar.
- Energy bar.
- XP bar.
- Level indicator.
- Currency indicators.
- Mastery indicators.
- Hellfire Meter.
- Ability buttons.
- Cooldown overlays.
- Inventory.
- Stats.
- Quests.
- Map.
- Shop.
- Trading.
- Settings.
- Notifications.
- Boss health bar.
- Event countdown.
- Player information.

The interface must be responsive for PC, mobile and tablet.

PC:

- Keyboard and mouse controls.

Mobile:

- Touch joystick.
- Attack buttons.
- Skill buttons.
- Camera controls.
- Responsive inventory.

17. GRAPHICS AND VISUAL QUALITY

Prioritize:

- High-quality 3D environments.
- Detailed character models.
- Smooth animations.
- High-quality particle effects.
- Dynamic shadows.
- Water reflections.
- Atmospheric lighting.
- Custom visual effects for each fruit.
- Distinctive transformation animations.
- Environment destruction effects where supported.
- Realistic-looking impact effects.

Hellfire must have its signature orange and dark-red flame aesthetic, glowing embers, smoke, heat distortion, flame trails and dramatic transformation effects.

18. MULTIPLAYER

Implement:

- Multiplayer servers.
- Player synchronization.
- Player interactions.
- PvP.
- Party system.
- Trading.
- Boss cooperation.
- Raids.
- Player name tags.
- Player levels.
- Bounty/Honor.
- Safe zones.

All important game information must be validated server-side.

Prevent duplicated rewards, invalid purchases and inventory exploits.

19. AUDIO SYSTEM

Add separate sounds for:

- Walking.
- Running.
- Jumping.
- Dashing.
- Swimming.
- Water.
- Ocean ambience.
- Island ambience.
- NPC dialogue.
- Quest acceptance.
- Quest completion.
- Level-up.
- Fruit abilities.
- Transformations.
- Boss entrances.
- Boss attacks.
- Boss defeat.
- UI interactions.
- Event announcements.

Hellfire must have a unique audio identity, including flame ambience, transformation sounds, magical energy effects and ability sound effects.

20. FINAL DEVELOPMENT REQUIREMENTS

IMPORTANT:

1. Do not create a non-functional visual mockup.
2. Every visible button must work.
3. Every fruit ability must actually function.
4. Every NPC must have functional interactions.
5. Every quest must have working objectives and rewards.
6. Every island must be accessible.
7. Every sea must be explorable.
8. All inventory changes must persist.
9. Player progression must save.
10. Multiplayer functionality must work.
11. Implement proper collision detection.
12. Optimize performance for low-end devices.
13. Avoid unnecessary loading screens.
14. Create proper save and loading systems.
15. Do not silently omit complicated features.

21. DEVELOPMENT ORDER

Develop the project in stages:

Stage 1: Core game engine, character controller, camera and movement.

Stage 2: World map, islands, ocean and all three seas.

Stage 3: Player progression, levels, XP and stats.

Stage 4: NPCs, quests, enemies and bosses.

Stage 5: Fruits, fruit abilities, mastery and transformations.

Stage 6: Hellfire Gas mutation, all abilities, passives and transformed moveset.

Stage 7: Swords, guns, fighting styles, races and Haki.

Stage 8: Inventory, economy, shops and trading.

Stage 9: Halloween 2026 event, Trick-or-Treat and raid bosses.

Stage 10: Multiplayer, saving, optimization, UI and final testing.

Do not sacrifice functionality for appearance.

After completing each stage, test it before proceeding to the next.

Maintain a development checklist showing completed, incomplete and broken features.

The final goal is a complete, polished, fully playable three-sea anime pirate RPG with the full Hellfire Gas update content represented.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a playable, original browser-based Three.js pirate RPG, “EMBERWAKE — Ashes of the Three Seas,” with a functional Hellfire Gas combat/raid slice and broader progression systems.
- Verify what works and clearly identify unimplemented scope.

## Requirements
- Include three seas, combat, quests, bosses, fruits/mastery, inventory/economy, events, UI, audio, multiplayer, and persistence.
- Hellfire Gas needs normal/transformed movesets, meter/passives, effects, mastery gates, cooldowns, and costs.
- Include Halloween 2026/Update 30.1, Trick-or-Treat/Harvest Moon, event currencies/items, and Hellfire Gas raid at The Pit.
- Use original assets; implement visible controls and test incrementally. Do not claim incomplete systems are complete.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; build and test.

## Decisions
- Use an original browser-based Three.js adventure.
- Treat the broad scope as staged work; do not present unsupported multiplayer, full content, or cloud persistence as implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing interface and responsive styling in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- `app.js` includes initial Three.js environment, player/NPC/enemy/effect setup, progression scaffolding, Hellfire Gas normal abilities, and appended input, panels, local save/load, movement/combat update loop, and transformed ability branches.

### Active
- Validate and debug `app.js` after the latest edits; confirm the page launches and controls/UI work in-browser.
- Complete and verify the playable slice, including progression, quests, event exchanges, sea/island travel, combat, raid encounter, and local persistence.
- Maintain a checklist of implemented, incomplete, and broken requirements; capture and inspect a current screenshot.

### Blocked
- No test/run/browser verification has been performed after the latest edits; runtime behavior and syntax remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check app.js` and launch the project; fix any syntax or runtime errors.
2. Exercise start, movement, combat, quests, abilities/transformation, UI panels, travel, event trades, and save/load; address defects found.
3. Inspect the result in-browser and capture a screenshot; document limitations, especially multiplayer/cloud saves and incomplete content.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay implementation; recently expanded but unverified.
- `index.html`: HUD, controls, panels, and start screen.
- `styles.css`: responsive interface styling.
- `start.sh`: project startup entry point.
- `README.md`: existing project metadata.

## Important Context
- `app.js` imports Three.js from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js`.
- The latest edits added input handlers, panel rendering/actions, island travel, and game update loops; no browser test or screenshot is recorded.
- Changes are uncommitted and have not been reported as pushed.

- Build a playable, original Three.js pirate RPG, “EMBERWAKE — Ashes of the Three Seas,” with a functional Hellfire Gas combat and raid slice.

- Include three seas, combat, quests, bosses, fruits/mastery, inventory/economy, events, UI, audio, multiplayer, and persistence.

## Objective
- Build an original, playable Three.js pirate RPG slice, “EMBERWAKE — Ashes of the Three Seas,” centered on Hellfire Gas combat and a raid.
- Verify what works and clearly identify incomplete scope.

## Requirements
- Aim to include three seas, combat, quests, bosses, fruits/mastery, inventory/economy, events, UI, audio, multiplayer, and persistence.
- Hellfire Gas should include normal/transformed movesets, meter/passives, effects, mastery gates, cooldowns, and costs.
- Include Halloween 2026/Update 30.1, Trick-or-Treat/Harvest Moon, event currencies/items, and the Hellfire Gas raid at The Pit.
- Use original assets, make controls visible, test incrementally, and do not claim incomplete systems are complete.

## Decisions
- Build an original browser-based Three.js adventure.
- Treat the broad feature set as staged work; multiplayer and cloud persistence are not represented as implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game interface, responsive styling, Three.js gameplay, and UI systems in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `app.js`.
- Fixed the malformed closing parenthesis in `.vignette` CSS and initialized player scale and sword visibility from saved transformation state.
- `node --check app.js` passes.
- Chromium testing verified the canvas, start screen, play transition, quest acceptance, event panel/trade, inventory panel, and map panel.
- Identified Chromium’s 404s as requests for `/favicon.ico`; added `<link rel="icon" href="data:," />` in `index.html` to suppress them.

### Active
- Rerun browser testing after the favicon change and exercise gameplay more thoroughly, including movement, combat, abilities/transformation, travel, and save/load.
- Record verified scope and limitations, especially multiplayer/cloud saves and incomplete content.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rerun the browser test and confirm the favicon 404 is gone.
2. Continue testing movement, combat, transformation, map travel, and save/load; fix any defects found.
3. Report verified functionality and clearly label incomplete features.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay systems, controls, panels, local persistence, and transformation initialization.
- `index.html`: HUD, controls, panels, start screen, and favicon declaration.
- `styles.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `/tmp/opencode/emberwake-test.mjs`: Playwright smoke-test script; extend or rerun to continue browser verification.

## Important Context
- `app.js` imports Three.js from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Browser smoke testing exposed only `http://127.0.0.1:8000/favicon.ico` 404s; the favicon link fix has not yet been retested.
- A movement check reported unchanged coordinates, but the scripted key press may not have focused the game; movement remains unverified.
- The map, event, and combat systems are local gameplay; Settings explicitly says multiplayer and cloud saves are not connected.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files were untracked in the last `git status --short` output.
